mode: Initial serial storage-buffered deployment under approved scope-preservation preflight

findings.observation: The cooked output run reaches the wall/side area behind the IN platform, while its exposed forward dock tip remains a separate capped deck. No supported turn or transfer mechanism joins the actual IN tip.
The outgoing counter belt starts at the house right/fuel-wall area instead of the separate OUT platform tip. The OUT platform is still a standalone capped deck.

The north-south timber counter has the correct staff-facing keypad and stock/register ends, but the intact east fence remains directly behind the customer side. Outside customers cannot reach the tabletop.
Pond rim/rocks meet the west fence, leaving no continuous paved outer walk to the northern front-door service aisle. The new enclosed-water site has not yet delivered its declared access benefit.

required_repairs: Extend both short dock decks forward by one belt width. Join the incoming cooker run to the exposed IN tip with a real supported curve/bridge, and let OUT travel forward from its own exposed tip before curving right to the stock buffer. Remove both mistaken wall connection stubs, including the fuel-wall attachment.
Open the east fence behind the customer face and seat the table in that service opening. Preserve correct staff keypad/register end and separate guarded pickup.
Inset/shrink the pond rim so an uninterrupted paved west strip visibly joins the north service aisle behind the rotated house. Preserve floor at the original far front-door side.
Retain the valid simple initial topology, source rear-house identity, correct raw feed, two main gates and central heater.
approval_boundary: Initial mode remains valid as a design choice, but this particular image fails its actual physical connections and access. No reduced geometric standard is applied to the simpler mode.
